figureNote: Courses listed here hash the import closure of their figure roots (paths under src/) into figuresSha256. Courses not listed keep the legacy two-file hash (figures-nuclear.jsx + figures.jsx). Roots are checked fail-closed: a missing root or unresolved relative import is an error. GC2 roots are the figure dispatcher (whose import closure includes the shared renderer files, including figures-nuclear.jsx) and the global stylesheet style.css (over-binding by design: any style change requires re-review). extraFiles (repo-root relative) pin the dependency manifest and lockfile. Bare package imports are bound through them. Unsupported dependency forms (require, import.meta.glob/url, non-literal dynamic imports) are rejected, not ignored. CSS @import and relative url() are followed.
